proposals.evidence: DEDR 1253 full article (p. 116) gives Kor. (T.) kekki , (O.) gekkili neck. Cf. DCV , no. 957. DEDS 163. Bhat gekkilɨ “neck” matches Lindgren Koraga gekkilɨ “neck” in form and sense; this cross-source match is a candidate lead, with the full DEDR article defining the family. Both source identities and dialect tags are preserved.

proposals.evidence: DEDR 1355 full article (p. 126) gives Kor. (M.) gedda id. Bhat gedda “field” is the same cited Koraga form and sense; its original dialect:Koraga:mudu:Mudu uncertain dialect tag is retained. The article is used as family classification, not an independent second attestation of Bhat.
